title: Uniform density bound from the local monotonicity formula with vanishing error
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U a subset of R^(n+l), V a rectifiable n-varifold in U with weight mu, H : R^(n+l) -> R^(n+l), p real with n < p, xi in R^(n+l), R > 0 with B_R(xi) contained in U; kappa := (p - n)/(4p), omega_n := unitBallVolume n, and mu(B_r(z)) below means the real number (V.weight (closedBall z r)).toReal. Assume: (hM) [the local monotonicity formula, i.e. the frozen sibling dohr_local_monotonicity specialized to V, H, p] for every y in R^(n+l) and reals R', Lambda: if R' > 0, B_{R'}(y) is contained in U, for mu-a.e. x in Bo_{R'}(y) V.tangentProj x is the starProjection of some n-dimensional subspace, x -> V.tangentProj x is a.e.-strongly measurable for mu restricted to Bo_{R'}(y), 0 < Lambda <= 1 and V.scaledLpNorm H p y R' <= ofReal(kappa Lambda), then there is F : R -> R with |F(r) - 1| <= Lambda and exp(-Lambda) <= F(r) <= exp(Lambda) for r in (0, R'), F(r) -> 1 as r -> 0+, Phi(r) := F(r) r^(-n) mu(B_r(y)) + F(r) - 1 monotone (nondecreasing) on (0, R'), and a real t >= 0 with V.HasDensity y t and Phi(r) -> omega_n t as r -> 0+; (hTP) for mu-a.e. x in Bo_R(xi), V.tangentProj x is the starProjection of some n-dimensional subspace; (hmeas) x -> V.tangentProj x is a.e.-strongly measurable for mu restricted to Bo_R(xi); (hLp) the lower Lebesgue integral of ||H||^p over B_R(xi) with respect to mu is finite. Then there are t1 > 0 and Lambda : R -> R with Lambda(t) -> 0 as t -> 0+ such that for every y in Bo_{R/2}(xi), every t in (0, t1] and every z in B_t(y) there is a real Theta >= 0 with V.HasDensity z Theta and omega_n Theta <= exp(Lambda(t)) r^(-n) mu(B_r(z)) + Lambda(t) for all r in (0, t).
